sources.excerpt: MXR GRAN TORINO BOOST OVERDRIVE | AllThePedals Articles Genealogy Browse Search results for " " Gain / Overdrive / MXR GRAN TORINO BOOST OVERDRIVE GRAN TORINO BOOST OVERDRIVE The MXR Gran Torino Boost Overdrive uses MOSFET technology to provide warm, organic overdrive tones reminiscent of classic tube amps. Featuring a 3-band EQ, master volume, and gain controls, this pedal offers both boost and overdrive modes for versatile sound shaping. It includes a Class A Low Impedance Output Driver to maintain signal integrity in long signal chains, making it a great choice for adding sustain and smooth overdrive to your rig. What MXR say about the GRAN TORINO BOOST OVERDRIVE The MXR Gran Torino Boost Overdrive harnesses MOSFET technology to amplify and enrich the natural sound of your rig with the the warm, organic sound of classic tube amps—and it comes with a simple-yet-effective set of controls to shape its tone to complement your setup. Setup is easy—just dial in your desired Master volume and Gainlevels, fine-tune it all with the 3-band EQ, and then choose your output mode with the BOOST/OD switch: Boost for cleaner notes and rich sustain, OD for smooth, mellow overdrive. On top of that, this pedal uses a Class A Low Impedance Output Driver to preserve the integrity of your sound and prevent signal loss across long FX chains. Get the MXR Gran Torino Boost Overdrive for organic boosting and goosing that you can tweak to match any rig. www.jimdunlop.com GRAN TORINO BOOST OVERDRIVE compared to ... sources.excerpt: MXR Gran Torino Boost Overdrive Home / Store / Pedals & Amps / Effects Pedals / Overdrive & Boost MXR Gran Torino Boost Overdrive SKU CSP033G $159.99 Quantity: 1 Allowed purchase quantity: from 1 to 10000 items Add More Add to Bag Go to Checkout Share this product with your friends Share Share Pin it MXR Gran Torino Boost Overdrive Product Details Step into a world of rich, organic tones with the MXR Gran Torino Boost Overdrive. This pedal beautifully captures the essence of classic tube amps, giving your sound an effortless lift that feels both familiar and inspiring. Whether you’re looking to enhance your clean tone or dive into smooth overdrive, this unit delivers in spades. Features The Gran Torino harnesses advanced MOSFET technology, ensuring that the natural character of your rig is amplified without losing its soul. Its intuitive controls make it a breeze to dial in your ideal sound. With the Master volume and Gain knobs, you can easily adjust your output, while the 3-band EQ allows for precise tonal shaping. The BOOST/OD switch lets you toggle between a clean boost for sustained notes or a mellow overdrive for those expressive solos. Plus, the Class A Low Impedance Output Driver maintains signal integrity, even across lengthy effect chains, making it a reliable companion on any stage. Tone You’ll love the way this pedal unlocks a spectrum of tones, from fat and punchy cleans to warm, saturated overdrive. The Gran Torino responds beautifully to your playing dynamics, allowing for a nuanced expression that feels alive under your fingers. It’s perfect for adding depth to your riffs or warming up your leads, with an inviting character that makes you want to play longer than you intended.
